reviews.reason: The root settings CSS hook and decorative teaching portrait do not change public article, legal, navigation or rule content. The separate landing-preview review covers the new clearly labeled sample link.
evidence: Source diff review against 2be9c0ef: QubeTeacher changes only decorative portrait src and object-fit; qubeTeaching, siteContent, rules text, game teaching/hint components and their accessibility labels are unchanged.

CampaignMode source retains the stage rules, cloud-save and hint-scope copy in the Help dialog, stage medals and music guidance, settings-only equipment guidance, and the CrownHintRecovery control in Challenge. Run/stage IDs and free-practice versus ticketed-Crown behavior remain from the base.
ChampionshipCollection and RewardPreview retain QubeTeacher and the settings-only equipment explanation; opening a preview does not equip or grant a reward.

Local production export: all eight public routes passed inspectPublicPage with requireQube=true, internal links/anchors and robots/sitemap checks. This is initial-HTML evidence only, not browser or interaction verification.

433 related Vitest tests passed, including QubeTeacher portrait/content regressions, Crown entry/hint policy/recovery, collection ownership, dialog dismissal and board compatibility. Typecheck and production build passed.

Browser layout, Help dialog interaction/focus restoration, real WebGL presentation and modified-app mobile behavior remain unverified. No editorial or interaction conclusion is inferred from the static export.
